scope: Bounded read-only review of the 20 canonical open records at the pinned candidate. Repository source and retained evidence only; no new reproduction, account access, installed acceptance, customer contact or disposition changes.
ownershipScope: Owner boundaries describe responsibilities recorded in docs/NEXT.md at the pinned candidate; they are not a live availability claim or a new assignment.
conclusions: No whole original incident has sufficient exact acceptance evidence for closure in this bounded review. This does not mean 20 demonstrated current production defects.

0db3e69c has directly verified controlled source repair; preserve its separate integrated/native/owner acceptance condition. Several other rows have independently repaired narrower defects, not established customer causes.
Unknown provenance/charges, stale diagnostic tails, report absence and adjacent green suites must not be promoted to current defect/cause/recovery evidence.
Canonical source status, installer verification and customer recovery are distinct; no customer confirmation or installed release coverage is inferred from source gates.

statusSemantics.open: An unresolved acceptance or causal question, not automatically a demonstrated current production defect.
statusSemantics.sourceVerified: A specifically reproduced source defect has repair evidence within the stated fixture/runtime scope. It does not establish delivery or recovery of a different original incident.
statusSemantics.unknown: Cause or affected-condition acceptance remains unproved; adjacent source changes and passing checks are insufficient.
statusSemantics.closure: No whole original incident in these 20 has sufficient exact acceptance evidence for closure in this review. Installer verification and customer recovery remain separate fields.
